series.name: Table C — Older MKS service tables
series.notes: Secondary mirror service faults: 10 fan locked off, 11 Main relay failed, 12 AC over current, 13 AC over voltage. Medium confidence.

meaning.en: Main relay failed (older MKS service firmware table).
meaning.ur: Main relay kharab ho gaya (purani MKS service firmware table).

causes.en: Relay contacts burnt or welded together.
causes.ur: Relay ke contacts jal gaye ya aapas mein chipak gaye.

causes.en: Relay coil supply missing on the main board.
causes.ur: Main board par relay coil ka supply nahin aa raha.

solutions.en: Switch off AC input and PV and wait 5 minutes before opening the unit; the main relay carries mains voltage.
solutions.ur: Unit khole se pehle AC input aur PV band kar ke 5 minute intezar karein; main relay mains voltage leta hai.

solutions.en: Listen for the relay click at power-on and check the main board relay for burnt or pitted contacts.
solutions.ur: Power on par relay ka click sun kar dekhein aur main board relay ke contacts jal ya kharab to nahin, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: If the relay does not switch or the contacts are burnt, replace the main relay on the main board and retest.
solutions.ur: Agar relay switch nahin hoti ya contacts jal gaye hain, to main board par main relay badal kar dobara test karein.

notes.en: COLLISION with MKS II fault 11 (PV over voltage) and InfiniSolar 11 (PV voltage over). Secondary mirror → medium. Also service faults 10/12/13 with old meanings (see table below in Conflicts). Platform reference entry (table source SRC-MKSSVC). Local brand rows may match but keep brand code space separate.
notes.ur: Isay MKS II fault 11 (PV over voltage) aur InfiniSolar 11 (PV voltage over) ke sath COLLISION hai. Secondary mirror → medium. Sath hi service faults 10/12/13 purane meanings ke sath hain (Conflicts ki table dekhein). Yeh platform ka reference entry hai (table source SRC-MKSSVC). Local brand ki rows mil sakti hain, magar brand ka code space alag rakhein.
